# Unsupported spec routes — OpenAPI operations not yet covered by a typed client handler.
#
# Each line is `METHOD /normalized/path` where `{}` is a path parameter.
# The route-coverage test (tests/openapi_route_coverage.rs) treats these as
# INTENTIONALLY deferred: a spec route is allowed to be uncovered only if it is
# listed here. Reconciling and shrinking this list is tracked in #72.
#
# To remove an entry: implement the handler, then delete the line — the test
# will fail if a listed route is actually covered (no stale entries allowed).
#
# As of #72 every advertised spec route was covered by a typed handler. Add a
# `METHOD /path` line here only when a new spec route is deliberately left
# unimplemented, with a comment saying why.

# Agent Memory - Stores (added upstream October 2026). Deferred: a brand-new
# product surface (10 operations, 32 schemas, its own RFC 7807 error shape
# `MemoryProblemDetails`) that deserves a dedicated, reviewed handler rather
# than being folded into a spec refresh. Reachable today via the raw client.
GET /memory-stores
POST /memory-stores
GET /memory-stores/{storeId}
PATCH /memory-stores/{storeId}
DELETE /memory-stores/{storeId}
GET /memory-stores/{storeId}/api-keys
POST /memory-stores/{storeId}/api-keys
DELETE /memory-stores/{storeId}/api-keys/{apiKeyId}
DELETE /memory-stores/{storeId}/entries
DELETE /memory-stores/{storeId}/session-memory
